description: List every game server the authenticated account can manage (own servers plus team-shared ones) with id, game, status and address. Call this first to discover server ids for the other tools.
name: list_servers

count.description: How many servers the account can manage.

hibernating.description: True when the server is asleep; it wakes automatically when a player joins.

id.description: Server id (server_...) accepted by every other tool.

software.description: Server software and version, e.g. "Paper 1.21.8". Empty when unknown.

status.description: Current status, e.g. Online, Stopped, Starting.

title: List Servers
